from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
ROOT=Path('/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/runs/td3/juggle_long_reference_20261101')
REPO=Path('/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl')
CMD=['/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/.venv/bin/python', '-u', '-m', 'scripts.td3.juggle_survival', '--run-dir', '/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/runs/td3/juggle_long_reference_20261101/frozen_target_3m6', '--scenario-set', 'training', '--episodes', '32', '--horizon', '100000', '--seed-base', '9000000', '--gif-steps', '200', '--out-dir', '/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/runs/td3/juggle_long_reference_20261101/independent_100k_eval']
SHA='c8a1df78ade41cfbe6845a84f4b21480f512973be7a89f0baf66daf5d452b31b'

def save(status,**extra):
    (ROOT/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status=status,updated_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),**extra),indent=2)+'\n')
try:
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'frozen_target_3m6/model.pth').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==SHA
    save('evaluating')
    subprocess.run(CMD,cwd=REPO,check=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'frozen_target_3m6/model.pth').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==SHA
    subprocess.run([CMD[0],'-m','scripts.analysis.juggle_motion_metrics','--results',str(ROOT/'independent_100k_eval/results.json')],cwd=REPO,check=True)
    save('complete')
except Exception as exc:
    save('failed',error=repr(exc))
    raise
